hints.title: Running Modular Arithmetic
hints.text: A binary number extended by appending a bit b has value 2 * current + b. Because we only care about divisibility by 5, keep only the value modulo 5 at each step.

hints.title: Preventing Integer Overflow
hints.text: The binary string can be up to 100,000 bits long, which would overflow 64-bit integer types. Modulo arithmetic ensures the working state remains within [0, 4].

hints.title: Boolean Mapping
hints.text: For each bit in nums, update cur = (cur * 2 + bit) % 5. Append true to the result array if cur is 0, otherwise append false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of binary array nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting the full binary prefix to a large integer causes arithmetic overflow and O(N^2) bigint operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modulo arithmetic keeps state in [0, 4], requiring O(1) extra space beyond the result list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that remainder modulo 5 can be maintained online without bigint conversions.
